name: Ghost Cab - A Ghostly Adventure
source:
"Ghost cab - A Ghostly Adventure" follows you, a ghost, working late night at your lame job with your lame boss. Nobody else showed up tonight so you've got to pick up the slack! Can you make the right choices or will you end up right back where you started.

[edited from [url=https://onlineatpt.itch.io/ghost-cab-a-ghostly-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《幽灵出租车 - 幽灵历险》讲述了你，一个幽灵，和你蹩脚的老板一起工作到深夜的蹩脚工作。今晚没有其他人出现，所以你必须收拾残局！你能否做出正确的选择，或者最终会回到起点。

[编辑自[url=https://onlineatpt.itch.io/ghost-cab-a-ghostly-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
